title: migrations.rs identity map_err wraps error in same variant
description: In crates/transit/src/migrations.rs, map_err(|e| sqlx::migrate::MigrateError::Execute(e)) wraps an error in the Execute variant unnecessarily — the closure argument e is already of the correct type and no transformation is performed. This is a no-op that adds noise. Remove the map_err or use ? directly.
